sources.title: Model lifecycle and updates
sources.evidence: Live release history names qwen3-coder-plus and its July snapshot: China release 2025-07-22, international/global release 2025-07-23. It separately lists the September 23 snapshot and describes code generation, tool calls, environment interaction and autonomous programming.

sources.title: Qwen3-Coder: Agentic Coding in the World
sources.evidence: July 22, 2025 announcement identifies the open Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct checkpoint as 480B total/35B active MoE. Its Cline instructions pair that checkpoint name with qwen3-coder-plus. This establishes a launch association, not immutable equivalence of later hosted snapshots.

sources.title: Model Studio pricing — historical search-index copy
sources.evidence: Search-index copy explicitly maps qwen3-coder-plus to qwen3-coder-plus-2025-09-23. This is historical documentation, not evidence that the endpoint still operates.

sources.title: qwen3-coder-plus model card — historical search-index copy
sources.evidence: Indexed exact-model card lists text input/output, Context Window 1000000 and maximum output 65536. Function Calling is supported for China but marked unsupported in international/global sections. Live fetch exceeded the web parser limit; a direct English-page fetch showed redirects to the model overview. Treat the card as historical only.

sources.title: Text generation — historical indexed table and current page
sources.evidence: Search-index copy dated September 11, 2026 lists qwen3-coder-plus with 1M context and supported Thinking mode and Function Calling. Live page updated October 15 omits Plus. The historical thinking claim conflicts with the Dataphin model-specific table.

sources.title: Dataphin built-in model specifications
sources.evidence: Live table identifies qwen3-coder-plus as an Alibaba Cloud Qwen3-based coding/tool-use model and explicitly marks deep thinking unsupported in Dataphin.

sources.title: Announcement: Model retirement for DataWorks Data Agent
sources.evidence: October 8, 2026 announcement lists qwen3-coder-plus among DataWorks models retiring in phases from October 10, with qwen3.7-plus as replacement and region-dependent availability. This does not independently prove every Model Studio endpoint is retired.

name.note: Readable formatting of the official qwen3-coder-plus identifier.

developer.note: Alibaba Cloud documents this Qwen model as its own offering.

family.note: Official release description identifies it as based on Qwen3.

release_date.note: Earliest explicit availability is July 22 in China; international/global service followed July 23.

open_weights.note: Launch instructions associate the API with an open checkpoint, but later documentation maps the alias to the September snapshot. No exact downloadable weights or explicit equivalence for that snapshot was established; neither true nor false is fully verified.

license.note: No weight license established for the exact later hosted alias. Do not transfer an open checkpoint license to an unproven equivalent.

parameters_b.note: The 480B announcement concerns the launch checkpoint. Total parameters for the later qwen3-coder-plus-2025-09-23 hosted snapshot are not disclosed in the reviewed exact-model sources.

active_parameters_b.note: The launch checkpoint has nominal 35B active parameters, but that count cannot establish the later hosted snapshot count.

architecture.note: MoE is documented for the launch checkpoint; latest documented hosted alias is a later snapshot without an exact architecture disclosure. Qwen3-based alone is insufficient.

context_window.note: Last documented exact hosted-card limit is decimal 1,000,000 tokens, correcting 1,048,576. Historical search-index evidence; current endpoint operation was not tested.

modalities.note: Exact hosted model card lists text input and output. Historical documentation only.

reasoning.note: Conflicting primary documentation: indexed Model Studio table says Thinking mode supported; live Dataphin integration says unsupported. Baseline false is not universally established, and the current Model Studio table omits this retired/legacy alias.

tool_call.note: Release history explicitly describes tool calling and the indexed Model Studio table supports it. Historical model card has conflicting regional flags, so this confirms model capability rather than every region or present endpoint.

description.value: Hosted Qwen3 coding model for code generation and tool-driven programming.
description.note: Uses the exact hosted release description without importing open-checkpoint parameter or benchmark claims.

patch.description: Hosted Qwen3 coding model for code generation and tool-driven programming.
patch.notes: Hosted alias: launch instructions linked it to Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct, but later documentation maps it to qwen3-coder-plus-2025-09-23; counts, architecture and weight license for that later snapshot remain undisclosed. Context and modalities use historical indexed official documentation; current model pages omit/redirect this alias and DataWorks announced phased retirement from 2026-10-10. Present endpoint operation is unverified. Official sources conflict on thinking mode and regional tool-calling support. Release date is earliest documented China availability; international/global service followed July 23.

sources.label: Alibaba model lifecycle and release dates

summary: Correct context to 1,000,000 using the last indexed official model card; confirm international release 2025-07-23, text modalities and tool-calling capability. Keep parameters and architecture undisclosed for the later hosted snapshot despite the launch checkpoint association. Mark exact open-weight status and thinking mode unresolved; document primary-source conflicts and limits on current availability claims.
